# Vendored landmark art

The exact files that drew in game, copied into the pack as-is by `tools/build_dlc.py` (`build_landmark_improvements`).
They are kept here because `build/` is not in git and Blender is not needed to build the pack. Every file in a
model's folder is packed (except `.md` / `.txt`).

| Folder | Model | Source | Drawn in game |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Edoras/` | Edoras v2 (Rohan's capital, 2026-11-25, after the film still `edoras.jpg`): static part = the crag and its slopes, barrows, river, roads, stair, fences, boulders (30.0k vertices, 2048² baked); skinned part = log wall and wall-walk, gatehouse, towers, ~100 longhouses, Meduseld's compound (still bone) + the banner of the Mark (swings, 6 s loop), 28.9k, 2048² | `tools/landmarks/models/edoras.py` via `build_models.py`, every `.gr2` converted with `probes.to_stock_sections(zero_obb=True)` | Not yet: installed 2026-11-25 for the user's test |
| `MinasTirith/` | Minas Tirith (Gondor's capital, 2026-11-25): static part = Mount Mindolluin + terraces, walls, prow (28.1k vertices, 2048² baked); skinned part = battlements, bastions, gates, ~350 houses, the Citadel, the White Tree (still bone) + the King's banner (swings, 6 s loop), 25.7k, 2048² | `tools/landmarks/models/minas_tirith.py` via `build_models.py`, every `.gr2` converted with `probes.to_stock_sections(zero_obb=True)` | Not yet: installed 2026-11-25 for the user's test |
| `Erebor/` | Erebor (the Dwarves' capital, 2026-11-25): static part = the Lonely Mountain + the carved Front Gate (face, portal, gallery, pilasters, threshold, stairs, channel, river, bridge, Ravenhill; 23.1k vertices, 2048² baked); skinned part = the two statues, doors, banners, braziers, lit windows, boulders, all on the still bone (10.7k, 2048²); the gate's gold glow (`MEC_EreborGlow*`, bone `fxglow`) and five braziers (`fire0..4`) | `tools/landmarks/models/erebor.py` via `build_models.py`, every `.gr2` converted with `probes.to_stock_sections(zero_obb=True)` | Not yet: installed 2026-11-25 for the user's test |
| `Orthanc/` | Orthanc (Isengard's capital, 2026-11-25): static part = the Ring of Isengard, its gate and Orthanc (26.8k vertices, 2048² baked); skinned part = Saruman on the summit, the pits' timber, cranes, chimneys, pillars and chains, iron gates, banners of the White Hand, all on the still bone (15.8k, 2048²); the staff's white light (`MEC_OrthancGlow*`, bone `fxglow`), six pit fires (`fire0..5`) | `tools/landmarks/models/orthanc.py` via `build_models.py`, every `.gr2` converted with `probes.to_stock_sections(zero_obb=True)` | Not yet tested in game (awaiting the user's test) |
| `BagEnd/` | Bag End v4 (the Hobbits' capital, 2026-11-25, after `screenshots/bag-end.webp`): static part = the tile as Bag End's garden at ground level, the big Hill with ~1,600 cut-out grass tufts (painted sprites, alpha in the DIFF's bottom quarter), the arched stone front with its turf lip, the chimney, stepping stones (29.8k vertices, 2048² baked); skinned part = the door, windows, the great tree (branching bark, ~600 cut-out leaf-cluster cards), sunflowers, the white picket fence and gate, Bilbo and Gandalf with their pipes (v11: Gandalf in a long grey robe draped to the grass, belt, scarf, bell sleeves, hands, face, beard and hair strands, battered hat, gnarled staff; Bilbo with buttons, watch chain, collar, neckerchief, hands, toes, face), garden tufts, all on the still bone (29.3k, 2048²); the windows' glow (`MEC_BagEndGlow*`, bone `fxglow`) and flickering candlelight (`MEC_BagEndFlicker*`, bone `fxflick`: warm glow cards whose width = light, on rotation curves), chimney smoke (`smoke0`); the pipe puffs `MEC_BagEndPuffs*` (bone `fxpuff`): our animated model effect (`tools/landmarks/puffs.py`), 12 cloud cards on D3K8uC8u position curves, a 24 s schedule | `tools/landmarks/models/bag_end.py` via `build_models.py`, every `.gr2` converted with `probes.to_stock_sections(zero_obb=True)` | Not yet tested in game |

To replace a model: rebuild it, convert it the same way, copy the files here, and keep the file names that
`tools/landmarks/improvements.py` names.
